description.content:
Pipedream's Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes 2,800+ integrated apps and 10,000+ tools as a hosted MCP endpoint. The server supports both SSE and streamable HTTP transports dynamically with no client configuration required. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials; per-request context is supplied via x-pd-project-id, x-pd-environment, x-pd-external-user-id, and x-pd-app-slug headers. Source: https://pipedream.com/docs/connect/mcp/developers
